summary.text: Zach Lahn is a farmer and businessman who grew up near Sioux City and won the Republican nomination for governor in an upset. He co-founded a private school in Wichita, Kansas, in 2018 and was a registered Kansas voter until he registered in Iowa in October 2024. He runs an 'Iowa First' campaign that opposes abortion and high taxes and defends gun rights and school vouchers.

paragraphs.text: Grew up near Sioux City, Iowa; graduated from the University of Colorado Boulder; worked for Montana and Colorado congressmen and served as Montana director of Americans for Prosperity.
Co-founded Wonder, a private pre-K to 12 school that opened in Wichita, Kansas, in 2018, and bought a farm in Belle Plaine, Iowa, that relatives previously owned.
Registered to vote in Iowa on October 17, 2024; Kansas voter records show he voted in Kansas in 2018, 2020 and 2022.
